title: Zymo Research Direct-zol-96 RNA MagPrep
author: Opentrons
materials: to APIv2. --- * [Opentrons magnetic module](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/magdeck) * [P300 Multi-channel electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette?variant=5984202489885) * [Opentrons 300ul tiprack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips) * [Bio-Rad Hardshell 96-Well PCR Plate 200ul #HSP9601](https://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [Axygen 96-Deepwell Plate 2.0ml #P-DW-20-C-S](https://ecatalog.corning.com/life-sciences/b2c/US/en/Genomics-&-Molecular-Biology/Automation-Consumables/Deep-Well-Plate/Axygen%C2%AE-Deep-Well-and-Assay-Plates/p/P-DW-20-C-S) * [Agilent 1 Well Reservoir 290mL #201252-100](https://www.agilent.com/store/en_US/Prod-201252-100/201252-100) * [USA Scientific 12-channel Reservoir 22ml #1061-8150](https://www.usascientific.com/12-channel-automation-reservoir.aspx) --- 12-channel reservoir (deck slot 5) * channel
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect all hardware listed for the run: Opentrons magnetic module, P300 multi‑channel electronic pipette, 300 µL tiprack, Bio‑Rad Hardshell 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL, catalog #HSP9601), Axygen 96‑deepwell plate (2.0 mL, catalog #P‑DW‑20‑C‑S), Agilent 1‑well reservoir (290 mL, catalog #201252‑100), and USA Scientific 12‑channel reservoir (22 mL, catalog #1061‑8150).

steps.title: Prepare 12‑channel reservoir
steps.instruction: Vortex the magbeads and add them to channel 1 of the 12‑channel reservoir immediately before starting the protocol. Load the following reagents into the indicated channels: channel 2 – DNAse; channels 3‑5 – RNA buffer; channels 6‑8 – magbead wash 1; channels 9‑11 – magbead wash 2; channel 12 – DNAse/RNAse‑free water.

steps.title: Enter processing parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol interface, input the number of samples to process, select the mount side for the P300 multi‑channel pipette, specify the initial bead transfer volume in µL, and set the bead separation time in minutes.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the protocol script to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as shown in the provided deck map, placing the magnetic module, tiprack, plates, and 12‑channel reservoir in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tiprack, plates, and the P300 multi‑channel pipette according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated Direct‑zol‑96 RNA MagPrep workflow.
